title: 第592章 冰龟第595章 玄螟
content_zh:
“此地寒气果然惊人，若无特殊功法或御寒宝物，玄根初期修士恐怕难以长时间支撑，更遑论与人争斗了。”
许星遥心中暗忖，同时也对秘境内部的情况有了更直观的认识。
韩烈给的简略地图此刻拿在手中，显得用处不大，因为这浮冰所在的位置，地图上根本没有标注。看来进入秘境的位置是随机的，这也意味着，每个人面临的初始环境和危险都不相同。
“还是先离开此地，往深处探索吧。”
许星遥收敛心神，细细感知了一下寒气的流动方向，正欲离开脚下这块浮冰，前往远处被厚重冰层覆盖的湖岸。
就在他身形微动，即将掠起的刹那——
“咔嚓！”
脚下坚实的浮冰，突然毫无征兆地传来一阵剧烈的颤动！不是风吹浪打的那种晃动，而是仿佛有什么庞然大物，在冰层下方狠狠撞击了一下！
许星遥心中警铃大作，几乎在颤动传来的瞬间，他原本内敛的气息猛然爆发，玄根中期的修为不再掩饰，足下一点，当即飞身后退！
“轰隆！”
就在他刚刚立足之处，冰面轰然炸裂！无数冰块混合着墨蓝色的冰冷湖水四散飞射，一股阴冷的妖气，从破开的冰洞中汹涌而出！
许星遥人在空中，急速后退的同时，神念已然锁定了那破冰而出的怪物，心中不由一沉。
那赫然是一只体型庞大得惊人的乌龟。其龟甲呈深蓝近黑色，布满了厚重的棱形凸起，直径足有三四丈。头颅狰狞，覆盖着细密的冰蓝色鳞片，一双铜铃般的眼瞳无比冰冷，此刻正死死盯着许星遥，充满了暴戾与贪婪。粗壮的四肢如同覆满鳞片的石柱，爪趾尖锐，泛着幽光。一条布满骨刺的粗壮尾巴在身后缓缓摆动，搅动着冰冷的湖水。
“三阶后期！”
许星遥瞬间判断出对方的实力，脸色凝重。此妖龟藏身冰湖之下，借助地利，气息隐匿得极好，若非刚才那一下撞击，他甚至未能提前察觉。而且其妖力属性，与这方天地的冰寒灵气同源，更添威势。
妖龟破冰而出，动作却丝毫不显笨拙，反而迅疾如电。它发出一声沉闷如牛吼的咆哮，口中喷出一股浓郁的白色寒流，直扑许星遥！同时，粗壮的尾巴如同钢鞭，带着呼啸的破空声，横扫向许星遥的退路，封死了他侧移的空间。
许星遥眼中寒光一闪，没有丝毫犹豫。他心念电转，右手虚握，一柄通体晶莹的冰剑已然出现在掌心！与此同时，左手寒镜也已经显现！
“寒镜，凝！”
许星遥左手持镜，体内玄功急速运转，灵力狂涌而入。寒镜镜面光华大放，一道清冷如月华的冰蓝色光束骤然射出，却并非袭向妖龟，而是瞬间扩散，化作一片淡蓝色的光幕，笼罩了许星遥身前三丈的区域！
说时迟那时快，妖龟喷出的那道白色寒流，一头撞入了寒镜光华笼罩的范围。

诡异的一幕出现了！那原本狂暴汹涌的寒流，速度骤然减缓，其中蕴含的冰寒之力更是被寒镜光华同化，威力大减！虽然依旧向前推进，但冲到许星遥身前时，威力已然十不存三四！
许星遥不闪不避，右手冰剑轻挥，一道剑气斩出，轻易便将削弱后的寒流斩碎，化作漫天冰晶消散，未能伤他分毫。
而妖龟那横扫而来的巨尾，也堪堪到了近前！
“哼！”
许星遥低喝一声，不退反进！脚下在空气中虚踏一步，身形骤然拔高数尺，险之又险地避过巨尾的横扫。同时，他左手寒镜光华一转，瞬间锁定妖龟那颗狰狞的头颅！
“镜光，封！”
寒镜镜面光华瞬间凝聚，化作一道更加纤细、却更加璀璨的冰蓝色光线，照射在妖龟的头颅之上！
妖龟庞大的身躯猛地一僵，动作瞬间变得迟缓了数分，尤其是头颅的转动和巨尾的回收，仿佛被无形的寒冰锁链捆缚！它那冰冷的眼瞳中，第一次闪过一丝惊怒和疑惑。显然，它没料到这个看似弱小的外来修士，身上的冰寒之力竟然如此凝练，甚至带着一种让它本能感到压抑的气息，比它自己苦修多年的妖力还要精纯几分！
“破！”
许星遥岂会放过这稍纵即逝的机会？他身形欺近，体内灵力毫无保留地注入冰剑之中。冰剑发出一声清越的嗡鸣，剑身光芒大盛，寒气内敛，剑锋处却凝聚出一点令人心悸的寒星！
“嗤！”
剑光如电，直刺妖龟那相对柔软的脖颈之处！这一剑，快、准、狠，剑锋未至，那极致的寒意已让妖龟脖颈处的鳞片泛起白霜。
然而，三阶后期妖兽的防御和反应，远超想象！
妖龟在寒镜迟滞下，虽然动作变慢，但生死关头，其野兽的本能爆发！它猛地一偏头，同时脖颈处的鳞片疯狂蠕动，一层厚厚的蓝光瞬间覆盖其上！
“当！”
一声金铁交击般的巨响！冰剑锋锐无匹的剑尖，狠狠刺在了那层骤然增厚的蓝光上，冰屑纷飞！
许星遥只觉手臂一震，一股巨大的反震之力传来，虎口发麻。定睛看去，冰剑竟然只刺入那蓝光不到半寸，便被死死卡住，难以寸进！妖龟的防御之强，令人咋舌！
“吼！”
剧痛让妖龟彻底暴怒！寒镜的迟滞效果也因为其狂暴的妖力冲击而迅速减弱。它头颅猛地一甩，一股比之前更加狂猛的力量顺着冰剑传来，将许星遥连人带剑狠狠甩飞出去！同时，它张开巨口，不再是喷吐寒流，而是猛地一吸！
刹那间，下方冰湖中，无数墨蓝色的湖水被其妖力牵引，化作数十道粗大的水龙卷，冲天而起，从四面八方朝着倒飞出去的许星遥绞杀而来！

许星遥眼神冰冷，不见丝毫慌乱。他深吸一口气，周身寒气大盛，竟在体表形成了一层薄薄的冰甲！同时，他右手冰剑脱手飞出，悬于头顶，剑尖朝下，急速旋转起来！
content_en:
"The cold here is really shocking. Without special skills or cold-resistant treasures, the early Xuangen monks may not be able to sustain it for a long time, let alone fight with others."
Xu Xingyao thought to himself, and at the same time he had a more intuitive understanding of the situation inside the secret realm.
The simple map given by Han Lie was of little use in his hand now, because the location of the ice floe was not marked on the map at all. It seems that the location of entering the secret realm is random, which also means that the initial environment and dangers faced by everyone are different.
"It's better to leave this place first and explore deeper."
Xu Xingyao gathered his mind and carefully felt the direction of the cold air flow. He was about to leave the ice floe under his feet and head to the lakeshore covered by thick ice in the distance.
The moment his body moved slightly and was about to fly up——
"Crack!"
The solid ice floe under our feet suddenly trembled violently without any warning! It wasn't the kind of shaking caused by wind and waves, but as if something huge had hit hard under the ice!
Alarm bells rang loudly in Xu Xingyao's heart. Almost at the moment when the tremor came, his originally restrained aura suddenly burst out. He no longer concealed his mid-level Xuangen cultivation, took one step, and immediately flew back!
"Boom!"
Just where he stood, the ice exploded! Countless ice cubes mixed with the dark blue cold lake water flew in all directions, and a cold evil spirit surged out from the broken ice cave!
Xu Xingyao was in the air and quickly retreated. At the same time, his mind had already locked onto the monster that broke out of the ice, and his heart sank.
It was an astonishingly huge turtle. Its tortoise shell is dark blue and almost black, covered with thick prismatic protrusions, and is three to four feet in diameter. The head is ferocious, covered with fine ice-blue scales, and a pair of copper bell-like pupils are extremely cold. At this moment, it is staring at Xu Xingyao, full of violence and greed. The thick limbs are like stone pillars covered with scales, and the claws and toes are sharp and glowing. A thick tail covered with bone spurs slowly swung behind him, stirring the cold lake water.
"Late third level!"
Xu Xingyao instantly judged the opponent's strength and his face was solemn. This monster turtle was hiding under the ice lake, and with the help of the geographical location, its aura was extremely well hidden. If it hadn't been for the impact just now, he wouldn't have even noticed it in advance. Moreover, its demonic power attribute has the same origin as the icy cold aura of this world, adding to its power.
The demon turtle broke out of the ice, but its movements were not clumsy at all, but as fast as lightning. It let out a dull roar like a cow's roar, and sprayed out a strong white cold current from its mouth, heading straight towards Xu Xingyao! At the same time, the thick tail was like a steel whip, with a whistling sound breaking through the air, sweeping towards Xu Xingyao's retreat, sealing off the space for him to move sideways.
Xu Xingyao's eyes flashed coldly without any hesitation. His thoughts whirled, and he held his right hand in vain, and a crystal-clear ice sword appeared in his palm! At the same time, the left hand cold mirror has also appeared!
"Han Jing, Ning!"
Xu Xingyao held the mirror in his left hand, the mysterious power in his body was running rapidly, and spiritual power was pouring in. The brilliance of the cold mirror shined brightly, and an icy blue beam of light as cold as the moonlight suddenly shot out. However, it did not hit the demon turtle, but spread instantly, turning into a light blue light curtain, covering the area three feet in front of Xu Xingyao!
Soon enough, the white cold current sprayed out by the demon turtle crashed into the scope shrouded in the brilliance of the cold mirror.
A strange scene appeared! The originally violent and turbulent cold current suddenly slowed down, and the icy power contained in it was assimilated by the brilliance of the cold mirror, and its power was greatly reduced! Although he still pushed forward, when he rushed in front of Xu Xingyao, his power was already gone!
Xu Xingyao did not dodge, he waved the ice sword with his right hand lightly, and slashed out with a sword energy. It easily chopped up the weakened cold current, turned it into ice crystals and dissipated in the sky, without hurting him at all.
And the monster turtle's sweeping giant tail was so close!
"Hmph!"
Xu Xingyao shouted low and advanced instead of retreating! Feet in the airWith a false step, his figure suddenly rose several feet, narrowly avoiding the sweep of the giant tail. At the same time, he turned the cold mirror in his left hand and instantly locked onto the ferocious head of the demon turtle!
"Jingguang, seal!"
The brilliance of the cold mirror condensed instantly, turning into a thinner but brighter ice-blue light, which shone on the demon turtle's head!
The huge body of the monster turtle suddenly stiffened, and its movements instantly became a few minutes slower, especially the rotation of the head and the retraction of the giant tail, as if bound by invisible chains of ice! For the first time, a hint of shock, anger and confusion flashed through its cold eyes. Obviously, it did not expect that the cold power of this seemingly weak foreign monk would be so condensed, and even carried an aura that made it instinctively feel depressed. It was purer than its own demon power that had been cultivated for many years!
"Broken!"
How could Xu Xingyao let this fleeting opportunity pass? His body was approaching, and the spiritual power in his body was poured into the ice sword without any reservation. The ice sword made a clear buzzing sound, the blade of the sword was shining brightly, the cold air was restrained, but there was a bit of heart-stopping cold star condensed on the edge of the sword!
"Tsk!"
The sword's light was like lightning, piercing the demon turtle's relatively soft neck! This sword was fast, accurate, and ruthless. Before the sword edge even reached, the extreme chill caused the scales on the monster turtle's neck to turn white.
However, the defense and reaction of late-level third-level monsters are far beyond imagination!
Although the demon turtle's movements slowed down under the lag of the cold mirror, its beastly instincts exploded at the critical moment of life and death! It tilted its head suddenly, and at the same time, the scales on its neck squirmed wildly, and a thick layer of blue light instantly covered it!
"Dang!"
There was a loud noise like the clash of gold and iron! The extremely sharp tip of the ice sword pierced the suddenly thickened layer of blue light, causing ice shards to fly!
Xu Xingyao felt his arm tremble, and a huge force of counterattack came, making the tiger's mouth numb. Looking closely, the ice sword only penetrated the blue light less than half an inch, and then it was stuck tightly, making it difficult to move forward! The monster turtle's defense is astonishingly strong!
"Roar!"
The severe pain made the demon turtle completely furious! The hysteresis effect of the cold mirror was also quickly weakened by its violent demonic impact. It whipped its head violently, and an even more violent force than before came along the ice sword, throwing Xu Xingyao and his sword violently away! At the same time, it opened its huge mouth and instead of spitting out cold air, it took a sudden breath!
In an instant, in the icy lake below, countless dark blue lake waters were pulled by its demonic power, turning into dozens of thick waterspouts, rising into the sky, and strangling Xu Xingyao who was flying backwards from all directions!
Xu Xingyao's eyes were cold, showing no trace of panic. He took a deep breath, and the cold air around his body became so strong that a thin layer of ice armor formed on his body! At the same time, the ice sword in his right hand flew out, hanging above his head, with the tip of the sword facing down, spinning rapidly!
